Content: On a municipal map, North Avenue and South Avenue are straight, parallel roads. Diagonal Boulevard crosses both avenues as a straight transversal. At the intersection of North Avenue and Diagonal Boulevard, the northwest angle measures `62°`. At the intersection of South Avenue and Diagonal Boulevard, the corresponding northwest angle is labeled as `(3x-13)°`.
What is the value of `x`?

A steel pedestrian bridge uses `text(two)` straight structural beams that intersect to form an “X”-brace. At the intersection point, the top angle measures `118°`, and the bottom angle directly opposite it is modeled by the algebraic expression `(4y+14)°`.
What is the value of `y`?

`text(Two)` parallel high-voltage power lines run east-to-west across a rural valley. A straight maintenance access road acts as a transversal crossing both lines. The alternate interior angle on the north side of the southern line measures `74°`, while the alternate interior angle on the south side of the northern line is modeled as `(5w-6)°`.
guides/SAT-M/GT/checks/media/LAT-TAT-3a.jpg
What is the value of `w`?

`text(Two)` straight, parallel commuter rail tracks are crossed diagonally by an overhead pedestrian catwalk. On the outer side of the northern track, an acute exterior angle measures `53°`. On the opposite, outer side of the southern track, the alternate exterior angle is labeled `(2k+15)°`.
guides/SAT-M/GT/checks/media/LAT-TAT-4a.jpg
What is the value of `k`?

A timber roof truss consists of `text(two)` horizontal, parallel wooden beams connected by an angled diagonal support strut. On the interior of the `text(two)` beams, the angle formed between the top beam and the strut is `124°`.
guides/SAT-M/GT/checks/media/LAT-TAT-5a.jpg
If the consecutive (same-side) interior angle formed between the bottom beam and the strut is `(2a)°`, what is the value of `a`?
At an international airport, an active runway intersects a taxiway at a `text(single)` straight intersection.
If `text(one)` of the acute angles formed at the intersection measures `38°`, what is the measure, in `text(degrees)`, of the adjacent obtuse angle that forms a linear pair with it?

A solar farm installs rows of panels mounted on parallel horizontal support rails. A straight diagonal bracing rod crosses between `text(two)` adjacent rails. The acute angle formed inside the rails at the upper junction is `48°`. The alternate interior angle at the lower junction is represented as `(1/2z+18)°`.
guides/SAT-M/GT/checks/media/LAT-TAT-7a.jpg
What is the value of `z`?

A land surveyor establishes two parallel boundary fences on a property. A straight irrigation canal runs through the property, crossing both fence lines. At the northern fence, the obtuse angle on the northeast side of the canal measures `132°`. At the southern fence, the corresponding obtuse angle is expressed as `(4m-8)°`.
What is the value of `m`?
During an optics experiment, `text(two)` laser beams pass through a focal point and cross each other in a flat plane. The acute angle formed on the left side of the intersection measures `33°`.
What is the measure, in `text(degrees)`, of the vertical angle directly opposite it on the right side?

`text(Two)` parallel interstate highways run east-to-west. A curved connecting ramp begins as a straight overpass that crosses both highways at an angle. The exterior angle on the top-left (northwest) of the northern highway measures `115°`. An engineer needs to determine the angle located on the bottom-left (southwest) of the southern highway, which is expressed as `(3n-10)°`.
guides/SAT-M/GT/checks/media/LAT-TAT-10a.jpg
What is the value of `n`?
